Every geometry value is added to levels in metres (z_bot = bedLvl - wearC - tSB, line 38-39), so parameters and outputs are metres unless noted.

findings.text: arch-bridge-rule-engine.ts is byte-identical to rcc-slab-2-rule-engine.ts apart from the class name (ArchBridgeRuleEngine vs RccSlab2RuleEngine): railway_arch_bridge and rcc_slab are the same rule engine registered under two family keys.
compute() reads fields the family defaults do not hold; the code then uses its own constants: geometry.height_above_masonry → None, options2d.show_return_wall → None
